title: Audit complete GL3 direct-CNF semantics against an independent oracle
body:
The saved formulas in #4211 reach the normalized GL3 model only if the actual caller graph and complete Boolean clauses encode exactly that model. This audits that named gap, separate from support pruning in #4214 and free-mixing normalization in #4223, at source `ca0002008b497428f0b651501c4a220a9d2785e7`.

The written schema proof covers n>=1; the published CLI domain is1..9. A code-disjoint oracle was frozen before predecessor/source access. Separate integration checks all nine pruned CLI lengths and unpruned9: **680,919 clause entries,81,648 complete next-state equations,680,724 helper calls**, full boundary/support literals, actual one-hot/selector constraints, the defining true unit and exact variable/DAG partitions. Complete clause MULTISET reconstruction and independently expanded coefficient ANFs check different links; neither alone proves caller equivalence.

The unchanged direct-nine positive word satisfies both actual formulas; all ten full1512-bit prefixes agree with independent dense recurrence and separate convolution and actual packed/set source replay. The oracle retains exhaustive Boolean tables,1512 generic coefficient expressions and35 control groups. Actual helper, missing backward-clause, translation, dirty-role endpoint and typed-receipt controls discriminate. The excluded library zero-call calibration is explicitly not a defect in the published positive-length instances.

Task/overlap: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7, `formal-interface-lemma`, scope **changed** from proof-assistant formalization to this bounded written/stdlib interface audit. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2102#discussioncomment-19080164). Fresh340 open/draft bodies and live2102/hub checked; broader history/code/Discussion coverage remains partial. No construction/search expansion.

Validation: four registered Python3.12 normal/optimized warning-strict commands, authenticated nine-source input ancestor, separate proof/code reviews and exact public-byte preflight. Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-cnf-equivalence-audit`. Regenerated length7/8 formulas match authenticated predecessor-declared counts and SHA256 hashes; saved .cnf blobs were not downloaded for a separate direct file comparison here.

No SAT solve or RUP execution, minimum-nine recertification, physical-cost/supplier/native outer theorem or newκ. No selected-frontier change. **Open next question:** after fresh overlap/resource assessment, replay the pinned7/8 RUP certificates on another platform; compiler equivalence does not establish UNSAT. Model lower-bound admission and independent-human/formal-kernel acceptance remain separate.

Credit Brian Ross's strategy, direction, oversight, original equivalence argument and source implementations with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Hanson Sun seed18 and Josie Elliston length10/three-register lineage; James Reed's finite pin/seal review; and the distinct #4214/#4223 audits. Original NOTICE/license retained. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for the independently frozen oracle, source-reusing integration and separate review. Classical Tseitin/Boolean/group-algebra arguments are not new general mathematics. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge requested.
